issue_request: FHIR-43453 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6 SupplyRequest. It requested Request-pattern alignment: add SupplyRequest.replaces with a search parameter and map SupplyRequest.category to Request.category, SupplyRequest.item to Request.product, SupplyRequest.deliverFor to Request.subject, SupplyRequest.reason to Request.reason, and SupplyRequest.deliverTo to Request.deliverTo with the Jira caveat.
initial_application: Jira records application in commit 284febeeb5. That commit added SupplyRequest.replaces, the requested workflow mappings, and a replaces search parameter to core SupplyRequest source. The dormant local search-parameter source still has a copied id of ServiceRequest-replaces even though its URL and expression are SupplyRequest-specific.
additional_context: Commit 3b38b80cf2 later removed SupplyRequest from active core fhir.ini resource configuration and updated core narrative to point SupplyRequest readers to the OO incubator continuous build. A current core [resources] check finds no active supplyrequest entry. The OO incubator continuous build exposes SupplyRequest and has the requested mappings and a correct SupplyRequest-replaces search parameter.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. Editing source/supplyrequest would only alter dormant, out-of-build core source, and the current external SupplyRequest artifact already reflects the requested content.
